---
title: "Project configuration"
output: html_notebook
---

Shared configuration for the numbered analysis notebooks. This file defines
settings and file paths.

## Constants

These settings define the 2014–2025 timeline, computational limits, predictor
schema, evaluation groups, and input files.

The year assignments establish the intended separation between model
development, selection, calibration, and final testing.

```{r constants}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Run settings
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# "quick" for development / checking workflow.
# "full" for larger samples and model fitting.
run_mode <- "full"

# Seed variable - shared seed variable for reproducibility.
# Each notebook applies this value using set.seed()
seed <- 3308004L


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Timeline and temporal validation
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Separate years assigned to development, selection, calibration, and final testing.
# Keeping these roles explicit helps prevent later outcomes from influencing
# earlier modeling decisions.
development_years <- 2014:2022
selection_year <- 2023L
calibration_year <- 2024L
test_year <- 2025L

# Evaluate predictions across annual, repeated cross-sectional samples.
# "quick" mode uses fewer validation years to reduce computation time.
# "full" mode tests every development year that has at least one earlier year to
# train on, so the first development year (2014) is never an assessment year.
cv_test_years <- if (run_mode == "quick") {
    c(2019L, 2021L, 2022L)
} else {
    development_years[-1L]
}

# Forward folds train only on earlier years, so each test year needs earlier data.
stopifnot(
    all(cv_test_years %in% development_years),
    min(cv_test_years) > min(development_years)
)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sampling limits
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Retain all AI/AN-alone cases and cap the larger comparison and unknown groups.
# The sampling workflow adjusts training weights to account for sampling.
comparison_cap <- if (run_mode == "quick") 45000L else 250000L
unknown_cap <- if (run_mode == "quick") 5000L else 20000L


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model-fitting settings
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Use fewer trees in quick mode to shorten exploratory runs.
forest_trees <- if (run_mode == "quick") 100L else 350L

# Candidate numbers of predictors considered at each random-forest split.
forest_mtry <- c(2L, 4L)

# Candidate penalty strengths for lasso fitting.
# Full mode explores a wider set of values.
lasso_lambdas <- if (run_mode == "quick") {
    c(0.001, 0.01)
} else {
    c(0.0003, 0.001, 0.003, 0.01)
}

# Limit the rows used for PCA to control computational cost.
max_pca_rows <- if (run_mode == "quick") 4000L else 12000L

# Limit random-forest parallelism to control resource use.
rf_threads <- 2L


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Post-model diagnostics
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Enable diagnostics after model selection.
# These flags do not authorize selecting a new classifier using 2025 outcomes.
run_psu_bootstrap <- TRUE
run_predictor_permutation <- TRUE

# Use fewer diagnostic repetitions in quick mode to reduce runtime.
psu_bootstrap_replicates <- if (run_mode == "quick") 99L else 399L
permutation_replicates <- if (run_mode == "quick") 3L else 7L


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Predictor schema
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Define the predictors shared across the modeling notebooks.
# Race is excluded as an input feature but retained for later fairness evaluation.
feature_names <- c(
    "physical_days_group",
    "general_health_group",
    "AGE_BAND",
    "SEX_CLEAN",
    "EDU_CLEAN",
    "INCOME_BAND"
)

# Specify category labels and their order in one place so notebooks can apply
# a consistent factor schema across years and data subsets.
# "Missing" is handled as an explicit category rather than an omitted factor level.

factor_levels <- list(
    physical_days_group = c(
        "0", "1-6", "7-13", "14-20", "21-30", "Missing"
    ),
    general_health_group = c(
        "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "Missing"
    ),
    AGE_BAND = c(
        "18-34", "35-49", "50-64", "65+", "Missing"
    ),
    SEX_CLEAN = c(
        "Female", "Male", "Missing"
    ),
    EDU_CLEAN = c(
        "<HS", "HS", "Some college", "College grad", "Missing"
    ),
    INCOME_BAND = c(
        "<25k", "25-49k", "50-74k", "75k+", "Missing"
    )
)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Evaluation populations
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Defines two primary groups used for group-specific evaluation.
# Separate from the predictor list above.
primary_groups <- c(
    "AI/AN alone",
    "Other identified single-race"
)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Input files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Note: Each notebook must define project_root before loading this file.
# Builds paths relative to shared project location.
data_historical <- file.path(
    project_root,
    "data",
    "processed",
    "analysis_pooled_2014_2024.rds"
)

data_test <- file.path(
    project_root,
    "data",
    "processed",
    "full_slim_2025.rds"
)
```
